title: 2025 [THANK-YOU CELEBRATION] SIDESTORY: I PORTATORI DEI VELLUTI OPEN
lines: 01 2025 [THANK-YOU CELEBRATION] SIDESTORY: I PORTATORI DEI VELLUTI OPEN

DETAILS: I Portatori dei Velluti event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the Commissione di Fuochi d'Artificio, and redeeming from Event Store.
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
Event Stages will open in 3 phases:
Phase 1 DURATION: April 24, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7) - May 15, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Open Stages: [Quadriglia]
Phase 2 DURATION: May 1, 2025, 16:00 (UTC-7) - May 15, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Open Stages: [Splendida Cavalcata]
Phase 3 DURATION: May 8, 2025, 16:00 (UTC-7) - May 15, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Open Stages: [Decadanza]
[Commissione di Fuochi d'Artificio]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete Daily Commissions in [Commissione di Fuochi d'Artificio] by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: Carnival Canister (provides random materials)
[Programma della Parata]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Programma della Parata] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★★★★★★: Crownslayer], Old Siracusan Tailor Shop (Pieces), Module Materials, Invito Mistico, etc.
[Fiera delle Meraviglie Notturne]
DETAILS: During the event, you can collect [Invito Mistico] by participating in the event and use them to redeem items for rewards.

REWARDS: Crownslayer's token, Old Siracusan Tailor Shop (Pieces), Headhunting Permits, Test Collection -Species Plantarum for Perfumer, [★★★★★: Erato] & her tokens, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Parts, and more.
NOTE:
- Please refer to the official introduction for more details.
- During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in [Public Affairs]. After the event ends, this event will be included in the [Public Affairs].
02 2025 [THANK-YOU CELEBRATION] LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – WE MISCHIEVOUS FEW
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [We Mischievous Few], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Limited Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Lappland the Decadenza [Limited] / Vulpisfoglia
★★★★★★: Texas the Omertosa [Limited] / Muelsyse [Limited] / Virtuosa [Limited]
★★★★★: Figurino

In this [Limited Headhunting], players will get the limited Operator Lappland the Decadenza after a total of 300 rolls (once only) . This special 6-star Operator is a bonus gift that does not give [Headhunting Data Contracts], and does not affect the chance to get the next 6-star Operator in this [Limited Headhunting]. This count is reset at the end of this [Limited Headhunting].
NOTE:
- [We Mischievous Few] is part of the [Limited Headhunting - Celebration] headhunting series.
- [Limited Headhunting - Celebration] is Limited Headhunting.
- Vulpisfoglia and Figurino will become available in [Standard Headhunting] after May 8, 2025, 04:00 (UTC-7).

- Operator Rosmontis will be available in the [Headhunting Data Contract Shop] during [Limited Headhunting - Celebration]. The required Headhunting Data Contracts for Rosmontis will be reduced from 300 to 200 starting this headhunting.
The required Headhunting Data Contracts for previous limited Operators will also gradually reduce in future updates after they have been available for a certain period.
Available Operators from the current [Headhunting Data Contract Shop]:

★★★★★★ (300 Headhunting Data Contract): Lappland the Decadenza / Vulpisfoglia / Virtuosa / Muelsyse / Texas the Omertosa / Specter the Unchained / Nearl the Radiant Knight / Skadi the Corrupting Heart
★★★★★★ (200 Headhunting Data Contract): Rosmontis / W
★★★★★ (75 Headhunting Data Contract): Figurino
- Operator Lappland the Decadenza is currently ONLY available from the [Limited Headhunting - Celebration], and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting.
- Please refer to the official notice of this Limited Headhunting for more details.
03 2025 [THANK-YOU CELEBRATION] SPECIAL LOGIN EVENT OPEN
DETAILS: Log in during the event to claim reward on event page: Tango Decadenza Headhunting Permit * 1
NOTE:
- Tango Decadenza Headhunting Permit can only be used to perform a 10-roll in [We Mischievous Few] Limited Headhunting.
- Each account can only claim this reward once during the event.
- Tango Decadenza Headhunting Permit expires at: May 8, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
04 2025 [THANK-YOU CELEBRATION] DAILY FREE ROLL IN [WE MISCHIEVOUS FEW] LIMITED HEADHUNTING
DETAILS: A free roll can be performed every day during the event in [We Mischievous Few] Limited Headhunting.
NOTE: Daily Free Roll will be refreshed at 04:00 (UTC-7) every day. Daily Free Roll can only be used once a day and will not accumulate.
05 2025 [THANK-YOU CELEBRATION] LIMITED SIGN-IN EVENT OPEN

DETAILS: During the event, players can log in for 10 days to receive generous rewards, including: Exclusive Outfit for Sussurro, Exclusive Furniture - 'Lupo Cattivo', Emergency Sanity Concentrate, Orundum, Elite Materials, and more.
Day 1: Emergency Sanity Concentrate * 1, LMD * 30000
Day 2: Orundum * 200, Recruitment Permit * 5
Day 3: Skill Summary - 1 * 30, Exclusive Furniture - 'Lupo Cattivo'
Day 4: Data Supplement Instrument * 3, Expedited Plan * 5
Day 5: Tactical Battle Record * 20, Skill Summary - 2 * 20
Day 6: Pure Gold * 20, Cambrian Series - Travel Freely for Sussurro
Day 7: Data Supplement Stick * 10, Skill Summary - 3 * 8
Day 8: Chip Catalyst * 1, LMD * 30000
Day 9: Module Data Block * 1, Furniture Part * 300
Day 10: Orundum * 200, Tactical Battle Record * 20
NOTE:
Please refer to the in-game info for the expiration time of the Emergency Sanity Concentrate from this event.
06 2 025 [THANK-YOU CELEBRATION] MERRY CARNIVAL LUCKY WALL OPEN

DETAILS: During the event, players can get two trials for Fortune Strips after daily login. Consume trials to participate in [Merry Carnival Lucky Wall]. The Fortune Strips with the most Orundum will be awarded. Both trials for the day must be used before claiming the reward.
NOTE:
- There are 14 days at most for players to pick Fortune Strips.
- Players will randomly obtain the following amount of Orundum from Fortune Strips:
Orundum * 200, Orundum * 300, Orundum * 400, Orundum * 500, Orundum * 600, Orundum * 800

- If the amount of Orundum in daily reward is less than 400 (400 is NOT included), players will be granted an extra trial the next day. The extra trial cannot be accumulated, players can get 3 daily trials at most (including the extra trial).
- All the daily trials will be refreshed at 4:00 am (UTC-7) on the next day and cannot be accumulated.
07 2025 [THANK-YOU CELEBRATION] OPERATORS UPDATE IN PURCHASE CERTIFICATES STORE
UPDATE TIME: April 24, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Operators will be added to the Purchase Certificates Store.
★★★★★: Philae
★★★★: Contrail
New operators Philae and Contrail can be redeemed at the Purchase Certificates Store. Operator Philae and Contrail are NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Recruit.
NOTE:
The following Tokens will be removed from the Purchase Certificates Store:
Rare Vanguard Token, Rare Guard Token, Rare Supporter Token, Rare Specialist Token, Epic Medic Token, Epic Sniper Token, Royal Defender Token, Royal Caster Token
08 2025 [THANK-YOU CELEBRATION] NEW OPERATOR S NOW AVAILABLE
DETAILS: The following Operators will be added to the game.
★★★★★★: Lappland the Decadenza [Limited]
★★★★★★: Vulpisfoglia
★★★★★★: Crownslayer
★★★★★: Figurino
★★★★★: Philae
★★★★: Contrail
DETAILS:

- Lappland the Decadenza is currently ONLY available from the [Limited Headhunting - Celebration], and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting. - Operator Crownslayer is currently ONLY available to be obtained from event I Portatori dei Velluti, and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Recruit.

- After the [We Mischievous Few] banner ends, [Vulpisfoglia] and [Figurino] will become available in other [Standard Headhuntings] after May 8, 2025, 04:00 (UTC-7). - Operator Philae and Contrail can be redeemed at the Purchase Certificates Store, and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Recruit.
- Operator Lappland the Decadenza, Vulpisfoglia, Crownslayer, and Figurino will gain more trust in the event stages during April 24, 2025, 10:00 - May 15, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
